lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Mica! Old-Timer!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Are either of you two busy?

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Nope! I'm just chillin'.
I'm not doing anything either.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: A question has been burning in my mind.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: What is the most delicious thing

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: you have ever eaten?

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: You mean like food?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: This question popped into my head last night,

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: and I wanted to ask you two.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: I'll have to think about it.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: No problem.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: You think it over as well, Old-Timer.
This is a toughie.
When it comes to food, I like just about everything.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I know,

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: that's why I'm so curious to hear your answers.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I can see you're a dyed-in-the-wool foodie like me.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Still, what was the super duper most scumpdidlyumptious one of them all?

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Then how about you, Belorta?

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: What's the most delicious thing you've ever eaten?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I mulled it over for a while,

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: and I think it's the chocolate cake I had at Maid For You.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Oh, and the cream puff I had at the new cafe I just found.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Those were both out-of-this-world delicious.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: I haven't had either of those.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I'll have to take you some time.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: That'd be great!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Well, Old-Timer, have you come up with anything?
White rice with a pinch of salt.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Nice and simple.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: I'm a fan of salted rice myself.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Salted rice...?

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Yes!
What's wrong?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: A long time ago,

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: when Mica and I were at the orphanage,

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I remember eating something similar.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Huh??

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Food was scarce back then,

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: so both of us were starving.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I even passed out from malnutrition,

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: but Mica managed to scrounge up some rice,

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: season it with a bit of salt, and rolled it into rice balls.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I can't tell how delicious those tasted.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: I did all that?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: You sure did.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: So, I've officially decided:

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: The most mouth-wateringly delicious thing I've ever eaten

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: were those rice balls you made for me.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: I'm honored!

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: I'll have to make some more for you sometime.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I'd like that!

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: I'm actually looking forward to it myself as well, hehe!
